# Chane Terminal Nieuwe Maas .

## About this terminal

Chane Terminal Nieuwe Maas is a crucial component of the 24/7 logistics chain in the Port of Rotterdam, focusing on enhancing the operations of oil refineries and traders. Its flexibility significantly reduces demurrage and other delays.

results.content:
We protect the

world’s

most

vital assets

Through

deep industry

expertise

we ensure efficiencysafetyresilience

Be a step

ahead

In industries where every decision matters, staying ahead means knowing what’s coming — not just reacting when it happens. MISTRAS helps you anticipate risk, improve reliability, and unlock smarter performance through integrated solutions that combine data intelligence, expert inspection, and advanced materials testing.

[Schedule expert consultation](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/#)

#### DISCLAIMER

MISTRAS Group b.v. in the Netherlands offers inspection services, as a type A inspection body, accredited by the Dutch Accreditation Council (RvA) to the requirements of EN ISO/IEC 17020:2012. Our accreditation covers the inspection activities as detailed in the authorized annex bearing registration number I 371 and specifically excludes any maintenance, mechanical or repair services even though these lie in the capabilities of MISTRAS Group global activities & offerings.

## Uniting actionable data, human expertise and precision engineering

### DATA Solutions

![DATA Solutions](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/dkwhcmli/service-data-solutions.jpg)

#### Information to insight

From software platforms to monitoring technologies, turn raw asset data into actionable insights.

[Explore](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/data-solutions/)

### FIELD Services

![FIELD Services](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/gzljth5c/service-field-solutions.jpg)

#### Compliance to confidence

Inspect and test your assets to ensure they are operating efficiently, and detect damages before they lead to potentially more dangerous consequences.

[Explore](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/field-services/)

### IN-LAB Services

![IN-LAB Services](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/zvwiuygk/service-inlab-solutions.jpg)

#### Precision to resilience

With advanced technology, expertise and end-to-end solutions, we help you gain complete control and confidence across your supply chain.

[Explore](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/in-lab-services/)

## Innovation to keep tomorrow on track

### Storage Tanks

We use a wide range of Advanced NDT techniques for aboveground storage tanks and all of their individual components, including floors, welds, annular rings, roofs and more. MISTRAS inspects tanks throughout all phases of their operational lives, encompassing their construction and inspection identifying signs of damage including corrosion, leakage, cracking, and wall thinning.

[Learn more](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/industries/oil-and-gas/midstream/)

![](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/d2kbqz5t/hm-solutions-monpac-m.jpg)

### Traditional NDT

As an industry leader in non-destructive testing (NDT) inspection, MISTRAS offers an expansive suite of traditional NDT solutions as the basis of many of our asset protection programs.

[Learn more](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/field-services/core-ndt-services/)

![](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/gkilztxo/hm-solutions-lsi-m.jpg)

### Advanced NDT

As an industry leader in non-destructive testing (NDT) Advanced non-destructive testing (ANDT) inspection methods often require more advanced training and technician skill than traditional NDT inspections, but offer greater insight into asset damages.

[Learn more](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/field-services/advanced-flaw-detection/)

![](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/agmnlpak/hm-solutions-advanced-flaw-detections-m.jpg)

### Pipe Crawler Inspections

MISTRAS’ crawlers, along with Real-Time Radiography scanner services are strategically designed, advanced inspection tools that utilize Digital Radiography (DR) to check for abnormalities within insulated and uninsulated pipelines.

[Learn more](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/field-services/corrosion-mapping-screening/art-crawler/)

![](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/pnkdhdff/hm-solutions-art-crawler-m.jpg)

### High Temperature Hydrogen Attack (HTHA) Programs

MISTRAS combines extensive engineering expertise with a wide variety of (NDT) to address High Temperature Hydrogen Attack (HTHA) cracking in refining, manufacturing, and petrochemical plants.

[Learn more](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/netherlands/field-services/damage-mechanisms-inspections/high-temperature-hydrogen-attack-htha-programs/)

![](https://www.mistrasgroup.com/media/yssbcaqm/hm-solutions-htha-m.jpg)
